lines.text: All right. Here's how we're going to split up the scouting teams.
We'll have the Cinderella Team, the Siren Team, and the Drake Team.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: You must be quite fond of the Villain Union, Prince.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: You're even going on reconnaissance with them.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: could we be called the Villain Union instead of the Drake Team?

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Come to think of it, I don't see the leader of the Villain Union.

lines.speaker: littlemermaid
lines.text: Do you think she's cooking up another evil scheme?

lines.speaker: mori
lines.text: I wonder what she's got planned this time. I can't wait!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: I'll send you the coordinates. Come here tomorrow with the Villain Union!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: I'll show you all what your great leader can do!

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Then, I'll leave Grave in your care.

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Or... should I call you GraGre?

lines.speaker: cinderella
lines.text: Even the way you get flustered when I call you that is beautiful.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: I trust you will all return with fine results.

lines.speaker: bahamut
lines.text: For the brilliant Bahamut has deemed it so.

lines.speaker: behemoth
lines.text: We'll hold the fort, so go without a care.

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Of course! Someone's gotta look after the kid, right?

lines.speaker: leviathan
lines.text: Might as well be us. We'll feel a whole lot better keeping an eye on her ourselves.
Thanks, I'll leave it to you.

lines.speaker: rapi_red
lines.text: Yes, I'll spend some more mother-daughter time with her.
Clouds rush past us on either side.
Ziz carries us along as she flies toward the coordinates Drake sent.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: It would've taken half a day to walk this far.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: See? I'm actually pretty capable, you know...?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: You'll tell Drake about this, right? You will, okay?
It really is cold up here...

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Um... We should be almost there.
An enormous power plant stands where Grave is pointing.
The ground all around it has collapsed.
It looks as though the power plant is standing there all by itself.
We land and open the power plant door.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: I'll take a look around outside.
Grave hands over her flashlight and disappears outside.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: D-do you think something's gonna jump out when we turn on the light...?

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: All right... I'm gonna turn it on, okay?

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Really, now. Screaming in someone's face like that? How rude.

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: S-sorry, I thought a ghost jumped out at us...

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: I'm using my own electricity to keep the lights on.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Funny that a power plant like this doesn't even have power.
Now that you mention it, the lights never came on.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: The generator outside is clearly running.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: So a dark, secluded facility like this has got to be hiding something.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Why, it's practically the perfect villain's lair!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: S-sorry! I-I don't have the best night vision...

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Hey! What are you doing in the dark?! Intra-union romances are forbidden!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Behold, my ultimate technique! The most difficult shape I can create with my electricity!

lines.speaker: ziz
lines.text: Wh-whoa! What did you make this time?

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Anyway, first things first, we need to get the lights back on.
Yeah, I think that'll make things easier.

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: Hehe, then put your faith in the leader of the Villain Union!

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: I'll show you exactly what only I can do—
Just then, the interior lights turn on.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Superhuman, do you have a moment?

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: There's something I need to tell you.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Something's not right about this place.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: This is an old power reserve facility.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: It automatically kicks in when the power level drops below a critical threshold.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: I checked the external systems. They're functioning normally, but...

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: The voltage inside is practically zero.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: I've got it running on temporary power for now.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: The power plant is continually increasing its output to compensate.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Yes. If this continues for too long, the power plant could explode and—
Smoke begins to rise with a loud hiss,
as though the facility is overheating.
I've got a bad feeling about this.
The tightly shut metal door bursts open, and acrid smoke billows out.

lines.speaker: grave_p
lines.text: Why did the power plant suddenly explode?

lines.speaker: drake_p
lines.text: *Cough, cough* Hey, power plant, you know anything?
With a feeble hum, the power plant shuts down completely.
